fields.quoted_span: shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply
fields.note: The $50 cap, penalty tiers, Special Civil Part enforcement, remittance to the applicant, CPI adjustment and rulemaking duty all appear in the text. The Treasurer determines the adjustment amount and the Director applies it and publishes it; the requirement text leaves this detail out.

fields.quoted_span: first offense, up to $750 for a second offense, and up to $1,000 for each
fields.note: The $50 cap and the $500/$750/$1,000 penalties match. The adjustment starts January 1 of the year after enactment (2026), so 2027, and uses the CPI.

fields.quoted_span: fourth month next following the date of enactment
fields.note: Approved January 20, 2026. The first day of the fourth month following is May 1, 2026.

fields.quoted_span: fourth month next following the date of enactment
